testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-amount-off-category-coupon-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify amount off category coupon functionality

scenario.summary: As a guest, an Amount Off Category coupon is rejected for a product outside its category and below its minimum, then applies when the eligible product is raised to quantity 5 (flat amount x quantity). A registered user of a non-selected profile then gets no discount. Cart is cleaned up; no order.
steps: Parse the flat amount (categoryCouponAmtOff) and quantity (updatedQuantity)
Guest: add the other-category product (sku2) at qty 1, apply couponCode: no success, no discount; remove coupon and items
Guest: add the eligible product (sku1) at qty 1, apply couponCode: Invalid coupon code, no discount
Raise the eligible line (found by name1) to updatedQuantity and reload: coupon applied successfully, discount label visible
Check discount = amount x qty, order total = subtotal - discount, subtotal = price1 x qty
Sign in as the registered user (non-selected profile), remove the coupon and reload: no success message and no amount x qty discount
Empty the cart and log out
stateChanges: Coupon is created per run through the API (consumable COUPON_* key); the test only applies and removes it, no order is placed, so one redemption is enough
Guest cart and the registered user's cart: products added, coupon applied/removed, emptied at cleanup
assertions: No coupon success message and no discount for the other-category product (rejection row shows couponCode and invalidCouponMessage when rendered)
Below minimum: invalid message "- " + invalidCouponMessage, coupon row shows couponCode, no discount
Line quantity equals updatedQuantity; success message "- " + promoAppliedSuccesssMessage; coupon row shows couponCode; discount label visible
Discount close to discountAmount x quantity (precision 2); order total close to subtotal - discount; subtotal close to price1 x quantity
Signed-in non-selected profile: no success message and discount not close to discountAmount x quantity
Empty cart message equals emptyShoppingCartMessage; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify amount off category coupon functionality'

Step labels: '1) Coupon is NOT applied to an other-category product', '2) Coupon is invalid below the minimum', '3) Coupon applies above the minimum (raise eligible product to qty 5)', '5) The same coupon yields NO discount for a non-selected profile (user35)'

Profile: CATEGORY10 is an Amount Off Category coupon on MaxwellsHardware, discount 10.0, orderMinimum 300 (cart $69 at qty 1, $345 at qty 5): today the minimum is an order amount, the key models it as minimumQuantity <= quantityUsed (5)
Profile: sku1 z-4567890 and sku2 z-2300011 are active in-stock simple products
Discount assertions use the resolved coupon's discountAmount (role data), not the literal 10.00
The coupon applies to the guest and NOT to the registered user: allProfiles false, profile Anonymous (MaxwellsHardware's default guest profile); the user is in Retail Customer
Links: the coupon is created on product's category (categoryId @product.categoryId); otherProduct is outside it (notInCategoryId @product.categoryId)
orderMinimum left out: the minimum the test crosses is modelled as minimumQuantity <= quantityUsed (5), so qty 1 is below it and qty 5 meets it

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2b): notDiscountedForProfile Anonymous on product and otherProduct: the coupon is applied and its amount x qty discount asserted as guest; the signed-in Retail Customer step only asserts the discount is absent

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): guest cart (Anonymous order minimum 800, PromoAmountOffOrder): product alone at qty 5 -> 5 x price < 800 -> maxPrice 160; otherProduct alone at qty 1 -> maxPrice 800. The signed-in step (Retail order minimum 650) only asserts no amount x qty discount, so it is not bounded (5 x 160 = 800 may cross 650; a 10% order discount there does not make the absence check pass or fail)
